properties.name: state

customProperties.value: confirmed_absent only from an undisputed curated negative verdict with event scope; package context alone does not establish absence and zero rows never prove absence. partial means excerpts only; claimed means only a video’s own text; for captions, no observation is unknown, never empty. States rank present > unresolved > empty > unknown > not_stated: unknown, never not_stated, where held evidence is not yet linked. A Senate meeting is unknown for documents and witnesses until Senate committee-page links land (ct-gi01 R2). Captions are not_stated only when the recording is confirmed_absent or not_public.

properties.description: present, partial, claimed, empty, not_stated, unresolved, not_public, confirmed_absent or unknown; these never merge

properties.name: basis
properties.description: Which relation states it

properties.name: count
properties.description: Rows behind present

properties.name: reason
properties.description: Why a state holds, when known: recording_decision_unresolved_or_conflicting, package_context_only, video_text_only, excerpts_only, stated_documents_not_held, senate_page_links_pending, package_witnesses_unattached, member_appearances_only (empty: the people the meeting lists, on its own list or, tied to no meeting, on a print it links, are Members of Congress, perhaps with record entries, and no outside witness), nominee_not_listed (unknown: a nomination hearing whose list names only Members, so its nominee is missing), package_names_meeting_unlinked, recording_link_pending or recording_without_video_record; for a present transcript, the sources held (printed_hearing, committee_transcript, captions)

customProperties.value: The documents are silent; entity-meeting-coverage.sql always sets basis (a CASE with an else) and count (coalesced), so both are required; reason is stated only when known.

value.meaning: The meeting a coverage fact describes.
